title: Affiliate Application: MindStudio

payload.instructions: Navigate to https://mindstudio.ai/affiliate, complete application form for MindStudio, and record status as done.

url_chain: mindstudio.ai/affiliate -> 404 ('Page Not Found | MindStudio', served at www.mindstudio.ai/affiliate)
WebSearch found the real page: https://www.mindstudio.ai/forms/ms-partner-application ('Apply to the MindStudio partner program')

this is NOT a simple affiliate-link signup - it is a 'Solutions Partner Program' application aimed at agencies/consultants who implement MindStudio for clients, asking detailed business-qualification questions
left_blank_for_human: Mobile phone number (optional, not a business phone line for COSHUMA)
LinkedIn profile URL (required) - needs a specific human LinkedIn profile
Number of employees (Select: 1-5 / 6-20 / 21-50 / 51-200 / 201-1000 / 1000+) - requires a business decision on how to represent COSHUMA
What services do you currently offer to your clients? - requires human judgment; COSHUMA is a directory site, not a services agency, so this needs careful framing
Number of clients - requires a real figure or judgment call
Average client engagement (USD) (Select: $100-500 / $500-1,000 / $1,000-2,000 / $2,000-5,000 / $10,000) - requires a business decision
MindStudio username - implies an existing MindStudio product account may need to be created/logged into first (account-dependent field)
Are you or someone on your team a MindStudio Certified AI Agent Builder? (Select: Yes/No) - factual answer only the human knows
Have you ever implemented MindStudio for a client? - requires factual/judgment answer
What specialty/expertise do you have that would make you an ideal MindStudio partner? - requires human-crafted positioning statement
How did you hear about us? - minor but left for human context
Consent/certification/terms language and final Submit - human-only per standing policy

note_on_fit: This program is explicitly aimed at agencies/consultants who implement MindStudio for their own clients, not at content/directory sites. Before submitting, the human should decide whether COSHUMA (an AI/SaaS tool directory) is actually a good fit for this 'Solutions Partner' program, or whether a simpler MindStudio affiliate/referral option exists instead - this may be worth re-evaluating rather than just filling in the remaining fields.
